visualCharacteristics.purpose: Asymmetric linked news grid: one prominent lead story beside a stack of horizontal story cards
observed: Three linked news story items (image + headline), each linking to a UT News / event detail page; first item is the featured (prominent) one

contentPattern.structure: one row per story, two cells: image | headline linked to the story page; the first row is the lead story
notes: Repeating look-alike items that each link to a detail page (news articles) and change over time: a dynamic list, so Cards.

usage: Featured news and event stories that change over time.
reuseGuidance: Use for 2-4 linked stories with one lead; for uniform card grids use cards.
